notablePrerequisites:
Savage Beating exiled with a kick counter on it.
Zethi does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Zethi.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
description:
Declare Zethi as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Zethi triggers.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Zethi trigger, causing you to pay {3}{R}{R} to cast a copy of Savage Beating.
Resolve the Savage Beating copy, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
